## Project Overview

This is a Next.js 16.1.6 + App Router + TypeScript + Tailwind CSS project with 16 components.

## Coding Standards

- This project has 16 existing components. Always reuse them instead of creating new ones.
- Use semantic design tokens for colors (e.g., `bg-primary`, `text-foreground`). Never hardcode color values.
- Use Server Components by default. Only use `'use client'` directive for interactive components.
- Use `next/image` for optimized images and `next/link` for client-side navigation.
- Always provide explicit types for function parameters and return values.
- Never use `any` type. Use `unknown` when the type is truly unknown.
- Use Tailwind CSS utility classes. Avoid arbitrary values like `w-[137px]`.

## Component Library

When generating UI code, use these existing components:

**components**: BackToTop, Bar, CodeBlock, CommandPalette, CopyButton, DataList, Footer, MobileNav, NavLink, Nav, PageHeader, PageLayout, ReadingProgress, Section, StatCard, UserMenu
